title: ActiveUsersResponse
description: Active user counts indexed by time window.

windows.description:
A map from time-window label to the user counts for that
window. The keys are `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, and `365d`, and each
value is an ActiveUsersWindowCounts object.

ActiveUsersWindowCounts.description: User counts for a single time window, broken down by role.

total.description: Total number of distinct active licensed users in the window.

admin.description: Number of active administrators in the window.

publisher.description: Number of active publishers in the window.

viewer.description: Number of active viewers in the window.
